description: This Kotlin source file defines the InsertImageDialog class, which is a UI dialog component in an Android app. It allows users to input an image URL and description for insertion into a markdown editor, handling user input, dialog buttons, and returning the generated markdown. The class extends a base dialog class and manages view binding, user interactions, and fragment communication.

classes.name: InsertImageDialog
classes.description: A dialog for inserting an image by URL with description into a markdown editor, handling user input and returning formatted markdown.

methods.description: Creates and returns the view binding for the dialog layout.
